hint_device_type: First choose which web interface your SMA device shows. Open the device in a browser and compare it with the previews below - the login page and the dashboard both show which generation it is (click a preview to enlarge it).
legacy_device_help: ennexOS: Sunny Tripower X, SMA EV Charger. Legacy: older devices with the classic web interface, e.g. Sunny Tripower or Sunny Tripower Smart Energy.
caption_ennexos: ennexOS: login with user name and password
caption_legacy: Legacy: login with user group and password
caption_ennexos_dashboard: ennexOS: dashboard with tiles and a side menu of icons
caption_legacy_dashboard: Legacy: dashboard with the classic navigation bar
hint_connection: The adapter reads the device directly on the local network. No SMA cloud account (Sunny Portal) is required.
host_help: Host name or IP address of the device, e.g. 192.168.1.50 or SMA1234567890.local. Enter it without http:// and without a path.
host_error: Enter the plain host name or IP address, without protocol and without a path.
hint_login_ennexos: Use the same credentials as for the device's web interface. A user account with the 'User' role is enough to read values.
hint_login_legacy: Legacy devices have no user name. Enter the password of the 'User' group of the device's web interface.
username_help: User name or e-mail address of the device account, e.g. the account you log in with at the web interface.
password_help: Password for logging in to the device.
hint_polling: Shorter intervals deliver more up to date values but put more load on the device. The default values are a good starting point.
interval_live_data_help: How often live measurements such as power, voltage and current are read. Default: 30 seconds.
interval_full_help: How often rarely changing parameters and device information are read. Default: 300 seconds.
store_session_token: Store session token as data object
store_session_token_help: Keeps the login token in the state info.session and reuses it after an adapter restart. This saves one login on the device, but the token is visible in the object tree.
